Container.Name: applemusic-lidarr-sync
Container.Overview: Keep Lidarr following the artists in your Apple Music library. An iPhone Shortcut sends your library's artist names to this container every night; it matches them on MusicBrainz and serves them to Lidarr as a Custom List. No Mac, no Apple Developer account, nothing signs in to your Apple ID. Several people can share one server. Web admin with first-run setup, password + optional two-factor, per-person reports.[br][br]Before the first start, make the appdata folder writable by the container (it runs as uid 1000):[br]mkdir -p /mnt/user/appdata/applemusic-lidarr-sync && chown 1000:1000 /mnt/user/appdata/applemusic-lidarr-sync[br][br]Then open the WebUI and create the admin account with the setup code from the container log.

Config.Name: WebUI / API port
Config.Description: Web admin, /ingest for phones, /list for Lidarr

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: state.json: users, artist lists, lookup cache, admin account (keep it backed up)

Config.Name: API token
Config.Description: Optional. Token for Lidarr's list URL. Leave empty to have one generated (the dashboard shows the full Lidarr URL)

Config.Name: Reset admin
Config.Description: Set to true and restart to run setup again (forgotten password). Remove afterwards
